steps.en: Install the skill into your agent's skills directory
steps.zh: 一条命令把技能装进 agent 的技能目录

steps.en: Ask for a deck based on your article, naming page count and images
steps.zh: 说一句：基于这篇文章做一份瑞士风 PPT，定页数和配图
steps.code: 帮我基于这篇文章做一份瑞士风 PPT

steps.en: Walks the fixed brief: pick Style A or B, then a 7-question clarification
steps.zh: 按固定工作流选 Style A 或 B，再过 7 问澄清清单

steps.en: Copies the locked template and fills only named layouts (S01-S22)
steps.zh: 拷贝锁定模板，只往具名版式（S01-S22）里填内容

steps.en: Run the validator until the deck passes the layout rules
steps.zh: 跑校验器，直到 deck 通过版式规则

steps.en: Ships one self-contained HTML deck with presenter mode built in (press P)
steps.zh: 交付自带演讲者模式的单文件 HTML deck（按 P 进入）

value.en: A designed, self-checked slide deck as one HTML file - no slide software, no build step, no server
value.zh: 一份设计过、自检过的 deck 落在单个 HTML 文件里——不用 PPT 软件、不用构建、不用服务器

sources: README.md main @ 2026-09-28: 30秒开始 (`npx skills add https://github.com/op7418/guizang-ppt-skill --skill guizang-ppt-skill`; 示例请求「帮我基于这篇文章做一份瑞士风 PPT，控制在 7 页左右，需要 2-3 张配图」)
README.md 使用流程 1-9: 选择风格、7 问需求澄清、拷贝模板 assets/template.html / assets/template-swiss.html、填充具名版式、对照 checklist 自检
README.md Style B 瑞士风: 22 个具名版式 S01-S22、校验命令 `node scripts/validate-swiss-deck.mjs path/to/index.html`
README.md 演讲者模式: 点击右下角 P 进入演讲者视图；按 B 关闭 WebGL 低性能静态模式
